newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Monday with spinner and exporters showing little interest in buying when trading resumed at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) after a four-day break for the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival, brokers said.
Broker Nasim Usman said spinners had not started buying for their mills, which had stocks to last for several weeks.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 was quoted at 2,100/2,225 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), K-68 at 2,450/2,475 and MNH-93 at 2,460/2,485.

The KCA said exporters had shipped a mere 38,124 375-lb bales of cotton by April 4 compared to 1.73 million bales by the same date a year ago. Exporters had registered contracts to ship 44,317 bales by April 15, against 2.31 million a year earlier.
